NGA.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority against AI harms in Nigeria.
Document names no government body using AI for administration.
Only a regional statement that no West African country has enacted AI-specific laws; Nigeria is not named for it.

facts.fact: The report relayed by Nairametrics says AI is being applied in Nigerian social welfare programmes to map urban poverty.
facts.system: AI poverty mapping in social welfare programmes

facts.fact: The report relayed by Nairametrics says Nigeria's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy lacks explicit budget lines or projections and relies on external partners.
The document says Nigeria launched N-ATLAS in 2025, a multilingual language model supporting Yoruba, Hausa and Igbo.
The document says UNESCO followed up with training sessions for civil servants in Nigeria in early 2025.
facts.system: UNESCO training sessions for civil servants

NGA.note: Rack Centre and OADC facilities are named only as investments, with no statement that they are in service.
No ownership or hosting statement for a data centre.
